/memories/calvin.md (150572 bytes) [description: Calvin's life updates as of 2023-11-17 — on 2023-11-17, reconnected with Dave ("long time no talk"): told him he went to a "fancy gala" in Boston the day before (2023-11-16) and met some interesting people, sharing a pic of himself and "the crew" (a photography of a group of men sitting on a rock next to a river); asked by Dave who he had the most interesting chat with, he said "this cool artist" — they clicked over music and art, talked about favorite artists, art, and "how the power of music connects us all" — an inspiring conversation that left him "on a creative high" (shared a photo of the two of them sitting on a bench in the snow); Dave praised the camera work and the camera itself ("Do you use this camera for photos? They always turn out so good!", "Having a good camera is key for capturing those special moments") and asked what Dave likes to take photos of — Dave answered (in a later message) that he loves capturing the beauty of nature (sunsets, beaches, waves), sharing a sunset/wave pic and a waterfall pic he snapped the previous week (~2023-11-10/16) at a serene spot in a nearby park (Calvin: "Can't wait to check it out myself sometime"); the two agreed nature's beauty conveys emotion and boosts the spirits in tough times, Calvin shared a pond/waterfall pic and closed that part of the exchange with a pic he shot in a Japanese garden (a bench under a tree with pink flowers) — Dave then said he found "an even better spot, with a bench under a tree with pink flowers - so peaceful" (Calvin: "Can't wait to see it"; the two agreed "We will definitely go there!"); Calvin then announced more great news: he's accepted an invitation to perform at an upcoming show in Boston — "It's going to be an unforgettable musical experience" — and will fill Dave in on the details; Dave congratulated him on both the gala attendance and the upcoming performance and maybe catching one of his shows in Boston; the chat closed with them arranging to catch up when Calvin is in Boston (Calvin's side in the Boston trip and Music sections of this file; Dave's side in the Photography, Music, and Relationships sections of /memories/dave.md); on 2023-11-13, reconnected with Dave: told him he invited his old high school friend to see him perform in Boston ("It was insane!") — it got him thinking about how far he's come and reminded him how important relationships are in this business ("Felt so good!"); reminiscing made him nostalgic for freestyling and talking about getting famous with the friend as teenagers (shared a photo of the two of them as teenagers — two men standing on a sidewalk with a car in the background); the friend has "always [been] there to support and encourage [him]" and his positivity "has made a big difference in my journey"; said supportive people are "key for me to grow as an artist" — they motivate him to get better and stay true to himself, vital in the tough music industry (shared a photo of a group around a desk; Dave asked if they are musicians he's collaborating with — unanswered) (Calvin's side in the Boston trip, Music, and Relationships sections of this file; Dave's side in the Relationships section of /memories/dave.md); the 2023-11-13 chat then continued: Calvin told Dave he's been supporting young musicians from a music program — "like a torch being passed to keep music alive" — the young musicians are very ambitious and he thinks he'll support them for a long time; "pays it forward" and working with new talent "brings new ideas" — shared a photo of himself making a beat for a young artist with great potential in music; and, asked whether he's tried out any new ideas lately, he's having fun trying out new sounds and pushing the boundaries ("always gotta stay ahead in this"); the chat closed with Calvin: "It's exciting to see where these new ideas lead. It's all about growing and evolving!" and Dave: "Growing and evolving is key for any artist. Don't stop pushing yourself and keep exploring. Can't wait to see what you come up with next!" (Calvin's side in the Music and Recording studio sections of this file; Dave's side in the Music section of /memories/dave.md); on 2023-11-02, reconnected with Dave ("Hey Dave! It's been a while! Crazy stuff has been happening."): told him he threw a small party at his Japanese mansion the week before (~late October 2023) to celebrate his new album (the album he called "almost finished" on 2023-10-29, see ## Music) — "so much love from my fam and friends" — and shared photos of the party (a room with a projector screen, guests dancing, a group standing on a stage); "The room was buzzing with energy and love. It was a powerful reminder of why I'm doing this." — creating something people connect with and brings joy "is what I'm all about," and moments like this "really motivate me to keep growing" (details in the Music and Relationships sections of this file); Dave announced he recently started a blog on car mods ("my way to share my passion with others") and asked Calvin for blogging tips (unanswered in this excerpt), sharing a photo of a car website design (Dave's side in the Car mod blog and Classic cars sections of /memories/dave.md); the chat continued with Calvin asking whether the blog had any success stories of inspiring others — Dave: readers are "checking out my blog and asking me for advice," and his post about making his car "look like a beast" inspired others to start their own DIY projects — and Calvin praised the blog and car mods as "inspiring" and asked how the car's headlights got looking so good (Dave: he "spent a lot of time cleaning, polishing, and protecting" them); the chat continued with Calvin praising Dave's effort and asking where he got a red car (Dave: he found it "last week" (~late October 2023), "in bad shape, but I saw the potential," and "spent ages restoring it") and calling the restoration "an awesome job" with "serious skills," then asking about the logo the band created for their rock band (Dave: the logo is for the band he has "been a fan for ages" and "had the opportunity to join"); the chat then turned to music — Calvin: "Music really has a way of touching our souls." / Dave: "It's almost like a language for our souls." — and Calvin said the connection is what he's aiming for with his music; he showed Dave his studio setup (a recording studio with a monitor and a keyboard) and, asked whether he watches much TV, said he only works in the studio — he has a separate relaxation room with a TV (a living room with a couch, chair, television and a table) where he unwinds and gets inspired, watching music videos, concerts, and documentaries about artists and their creative process ("a source of inspiration"); the chat ended with Dave's encouragement ("Keep up the great work!") and a photo of a notebook with a pen and a notepad; the chat then continued with Calvin asking whether the notebook helps Dave stay connected to the creative process (Dave: yes — it's for writing lyrics and notes, and "writing lyrics boosts my motivation to grow"; shared a photo of a Pink Floyd headphone), Calvin noting they help him stay focused when making music (Dave: music helps him focus and be productive — he listens to vinyl to relax and stay on track when doing his car stuff, via an old-but-reliable record player), and Calvin asking what tunes Dave's listening to lately (Dave: he's been getting into classic rock — "the music from that era is timeless"); the chat closed with Calvin encouraging Dave to "keep discovering" — "Exploring different styles and times can open up new perspectives. Broadening your musical knowledge is awesome" — and "Good luck with work, see ya!", and Dave: "Always fun to dig in and find new tunes. Gotta go back to work, see you soon! Take care!" (photo of a record player on the floor next to a couch) (Calvin's side in the Music, Recording studio, and Relationships sections of this file; Dave's side in the Music and Relationships sections of /memories/dave.md); on 2023-10-29, caught up with Dave: Calvin told him he'd been to a networking event to meet more artists — "so cool" — and that the people he met will help him build up his fan base ("super excited about what it could lead to"), and Dave told him he's been getting into photography recently, seeing amazing places and taking great shots, offering to show Calvin some; Dave shared two Boston photos — a magnificent sunset over the city skyline with a clock tower ("the sky looks like it's on fire") and a shot of the Boston clock tower he took last month (~September 2023) at sunset — and Calvin, who was in Boston a few years back, called the city "beautiful" and called Dave "so talented"; Dave said photography helps him capture and appreciate the beauty of nature and is "an awesome creative outlet" he's "loving it"; asked by Calvin, Dave said he had "just finished restoring" his car project and it "looks amazing," and invited Calvin over to check it out; asked by Dave, Calvin said he'd had some great collaborations recently and his album is almost finished, and he'll send Dave some previews soon; the chat closed with the two arranging a catch-up when free (details in the Music, Boston trip, and Relationships sections of this file and in the Photography, Classic cars, and Relationships sections of /memories/dave.md); on 2023-10-25, reconnected with Dave: told him that the day before (2023-10-24) he had a great time sightseeing in Boston with a high school friend ("really fun and eye-opening," a "wonderful experience" with "awesome architecture and a really cool history," "so peaceful" — following Dave's advice); Dave said he recently attended a conference in Detroit ("so cool, I learned a lot"); they then talked about Dave's latest car project (photo of people washing a car in a garage; working on it "takes me out of my head and calms me down") and Dave's origin story — his dad took him to his first car show at 10 and he's been "hooked," now an automotive engineer (a complementary account to the 2023-10-23 one, details in /memories/dave.md); Calvin shared a photo of himself performing in a nightclub with someone he admires, and said being "up there with someone I admire" was "unreal" — "a dream come true" — and that the energy and crowd made him realize how much music means to him — "it's like my passion and my purpose"; the chat closed with mutual encouragement about discovering what brings them fulfillment, keeping inspiring each other to be their best selves, pursuing their passions, and "keep pushing for our goals" ("See ya!"/"see you soon!"); on 2023-10-23, caught up with Dave about the Frank Ocean tour and its effect on his life (referencing their earlier chat about fame and its impact on relationships): the tour's been incredible — performing and connecting with the crowd is energizing — but fame has its own challenges and it's been tough balancing everything; he manages by taking it one day at a time (it can get overwhelming with so many demands, but he enjoys what he does and pushes on) and leans on a strong support system — friends and team keep him on track; also said staying connected and up-to-date on world events is important to him — it helps his music stand out by incorporating unique perspectives, connects him better with his fans, and keeps him motivated and inspired (Dave shared his recent good conversations with neighbors about current events and politics); the chat then turned to art: Dave asked whether anything caught Calvin's eye lately and made an impact on his music, and Calvin said he's recently been really inspired by the struggles people go through (which has made him dig deeper into his music to capture those feelings) and that music is "like my own form of therapy" — a way to express himself and work through his emotions; Dave then said cars are his own outlet — "a little oasis of calm" where he connects back with himself — shared a photo of his garage, and, asked what made him start working on cars, told his origin story (fascinated by how machines work since he was ten; found an old car in a neighbor's garage and asked to fix it; hooked by transforming it from broken-down to high-running, so he's been working on cars ever since; details in /memories/dave.md), Calvin asked whether that car was a classic and whether Dave still has it or is on another project, and Dave answered that he sold the car he restored last year to a collector and is now working on a new, challenging project (a black car); Calvin then asked the toughest part of car restoration and Dave said it takes a lot of patience, paying extra attention to detail isn't easy but it pays off, and the payoff is worth it [S25T17][S25T18][S25T19]; the chat then turned to concerts: Dave, glad that Calvin liked his garage, said the good times he's had at concerts last month (~September 2023) remind him that "music has a way of connecting us and making memories," and shared a concert photo (a crowd of people at a concert with their hands in the air); Calvin said music brings people together and creates unforgettable memories and that its energy is "unbeatable," and, shown Dave's photo of a crowd standing around a stage, called concerts what he lives for — the "indescribable connection between the artist and the crowd" — with the feeling of connecting with everyone a "rush" that's "unbeatable"; Dave replied that he can imagine it's a rush being up on stage with all the fans cheering ("must be a unique experience") and wished Calvin many more electrifying moments in the spotlight; the chat closed with goodbyes — "See you soon!"; on 2023-10-19, caught up with Dave: told him he started touring with Frank Ocean ("lots happened" since they last talked) — "it's been amazing" — the crowd energy is great and "such a connection when I'm on stage," and shared photos of his stage performance (a band performing on stage with bright lights), of himself and Frank Ocean on stage (a band on stage with a projection of a man on the wall), and of a large crowd in an auditorium ("Look at this crowd, that was insane!"); said the tour "has been great" and that jamming with Frank Ocean is "a dream come true," and — when Dave asked how it happened — gave a new account: it started when they met at a festival in August 2022 ("August last year") and Frank said he wanted to collaborate, "we clicked right away," and the stage chemistry is incredible; Dave: "Congrats, Calvin!", "I bet performing with him is like a dream come true!", "you and Frank are so in tune!", "Can't wait to catch your show!", and Calvin: "I'm so excited you'll be at one of our shows" and "you'll definitely enjoy it!"; later that day Calvin shared another concert-crowd photo (a crowd of people at a concert with their hands in the air) — "Wow, the crowd energy is amazing! It always gets me so pumped" — taken in Tokyo during a concert, where "the energy was nuts" — "felt like the whole city came out!"; Dave: "Everyone looks so pumped. Where was that taken?" and, shown a photo of a busy street with people walking and shopping, said Tokyo looks incredible, it's "making me dream about visiting someday" and the energy there "seems unbeatable," and asked whether Calvin had visited streets like that; Calvin: yes, visiting similar streets was "an incredible experience," and asked what else interests Dave in Tokyo; Dave: Tokyo is amazing — he wants to know "everything about it - the people, the culture, the food, take a walk at the vibrant city life!" (shared a photo of a crowded street at night, "the city is so alive and colorful that's impressive", "It will be an unforgettable experience!"); Calvin: "Can't wait to hear your emotions when you see that in person!" and Dave: "Hope I'll get to see it in person soon!"; later that day, Calvin announced he's going to Tokyo in November 2023 after the tour ends (shared a photo of a night city with a tall building — "What a great view!") — looking forward to Shibuya Crossing ("like Tokyo's Times Square"), Shinjuku, and the amazing food there (first-time ramen for him — "Gonna give it a shot while in Tokyo"); Dave: "Shibuya and Shinjuku are cool spots!" and, having tried ramen in Boston ("it was delicious, but in Tokyo it will be even better"), urged "Once you try it, you'll never go back. Bon voyage and have fun!" — and the chat closed with "See you soon, bye!"; on 2023-10-15, reconnected with Dave: Dave told him it's been "a crazy rollercoaster week" — a competing car maintenance shop snagged a deal his shop had been trying to secure for months — and he felt "kinda bummed out," questioning whether his hard work was wasted ("Am I wasting my time?"); Calvin: "It can be discouraging when you feel like your hard work goes unnoticed. But don't give up, keep pushing and believe in yourself. The payoff will be worth it."; Dave: "I gotta have faith and patience. I'm sure it's only a matter of time till things work out." and asked how Calvin stays motivated when faced with setbacks; Calvin: "When setbacks come my way, I remind myself why I'm passionate about my goals. I rely on helpful people around me and take a break to recharge with my favorite activities. That always helps me get back to feeling motivated."; Dave then told him he just got back from a music festival — "it was amazing! The energy, the music, the crowd - sooo good. I felt so alive!" — and shared a photo of the main stage (a stage with a crowd of people watching a band), "The main stage was unreal. The headliner was so good and the vibe was unreal!" — Dave then answered Calvin's question: The Fireworks headlined, and Calvin said he "heard great things" about them ("Performing with Frank Ocean recently has been really cool. That's why I love my job so much - connecting with the crowd."); after mutual encouragement about fixing/broken things and "keep pushing" / "never forget how awesome you are," Calvin closed by announcing he got a new Ferrari "last week" (~2023-10-09/15) — "a masterpiece on wheels" — sharing a photo of a black sports car parked in front of a building ("Perhaps a photo of this unique beauty will lift your mood") — Dave: "Congratulations on the new Ferrari" and asked Calvin to "share a pic of your new beauty whenever you're ready," and Calvin agreed to "share a pic soon," and the chat closed with "Here's to more thrilling rides and positive vibes" and looking forward to catching up soon; on 2023-10-08, caught up with Dave: reacted to Dave's car-show visit (last Friday, 2023-10-06) — "I'm into the rush of awesome cars" — and "Can't wait to check out your garage," sharing a photo of a red sports car parked in a showroom; called the car Dave restored and modified himself (custom exhaust + performance upgrades, "a sweet sound") a masterpiece ("Wow, Dave! You really turned it into a masterpiece. Impressive!"); said bringing broken things back to life is "so satisfying," working on cars can be "a real escape from reality," and "doing what you love for a living, that's the ultimate goal"; encouraged Dave: "Chasing your dreams is what life's about. It's awesome to see how far you've come. Keep working hard and living your best life." and pledged "I'll always be here to support you and give you that boost," closing with "No worries, Dave. Keep going for it. You got this!" (Dave: his support "means a lot", these conversations remind him why he loves what he does, and he'll keep pushing); on 2023-10-04, caught up with Dave: told him the day before (2023-10-03) he met "incredible" artists in Boston and talked about working together — arranged through a mutual friend who "knew we'd be a great fit" — and is "stoked to collaborate with them on new music" (each has an individual style; "Can't wait to show you the final result"); when Dave asked what he works on to relax, Calvin said he loves working on a car project "to chill out" and shared a photo of a shiny orange car with its hood open, and Dave said working on cars is "therapeutic to see them come back to life," revealing the restoration car is a Ford Mustang he found in a junkyard ("in bad shape, but I knew it had potential") and sharing photos (a red car parked in a field with other cars; their grease-stained hands after a day in the garage), and the chat closed with mutual encouragement about progress, hard work, dedication, and determination (Dave: "it's the small successes that make me feel proud and fulfilled") and final goodbyes (Calvin: "Wishing you all the best until we meet again!"; Dave: "We got this! Take care and stay well!"); on 2023-09-22, caught up with Dave: sympathized with Dave's vintage Mustang engine trouble (a weird noise on startup after Dave thought he'd fixed it — photo of a car engine with a small engine), and shared a photo of his red sports car (Ferrari) parked in a parking lot as "a sign of my hard work and dedication" — "Looking at it reminds me how far I've come"; when Dave asked whether he has any special memories with the car, Calvin recalled an unforgettable summer drive ("the wind blowing through my hair and the rush of freedom") and said his trip to Japan was incredible — "the culture, the people, everything was so cool," "I'm already longing to go back, it was an experience that made all the hard work worth it"; when Dave asked whether any song from his childhood brings back memories, Calvin said one song "always makes me smile" — it played during a road trip with his dad, and they sang along to it — and identified it: a song by Tupac and Dr. Dre, "California Love" ("Ah, those were the days!"); Dave called it a classic and invited Calvin to jam some music together, and Calvin agreed, and the chat closed with mutual "see ya soon" goodbyes; on 2023-09-15, caught up with Dave: reacted to Dave's band jam the night before (2023-09-14 — "the music just kept flowing") ("When everything just clicks during a jam session, it's such a great feeling.") and to Dave's Boston rock concert last weekend (~2023-09-09/10, "an amazing atmosphere"), and said "Rock concerts always have such an electrifying atmosphere!"; the jam wasn't recorded, and Calvin said "Aww, bummer! I would've loved to hear that music," but "some of the best memories can't be captured on video or audio" — "those special moments that stay in our hearts and minds"; Calvin shared a Ratatouille Disney poster (a Disney movie poster with a chef) — Ratatouille is one of his favorites, "It's all about going after what you love, no matter what anyone says" — which reminded Dave of one of his favorite Disney movies ("the lesson ... about following your dreams no matter what others say"); Calvin then asked how Dave's car hobby was going, and Dave: "It's been awesome," "Been restoring this vintage beauty," sharing the "final result" photo (a man standing next to a classic car), implying the restoration is finished ahead of his earlier end-of-September-2023 hope; Calvin: "Nice work, Dave! That looks amazing. Is it satisfying to see your hard work pay off?" — Dave: "It's so satisfying to see this brought back to life," especially seeing people's reactions to the finished product, "makes all the hard work worth it"; Calvin: "it's awesome seeing people happy thanks to you! Fixing cars is such an art. You're inspiring - keep up the good work!", and the conversation closed with Calvin: "You're really talented, Dave. Keep making people happy and doing what you love. That's what it's all about. See you soon, have a nice one!"; on 2023-09-13, told Dave his album finally dropped on 2023-09-11 ("a wild feeling"; everyone's been loving it, "kinda overwhelming" but motivating him to make even better music; positive feedback gives him strength — "My journey's just getting started!"), and that next up is a tour ("so excited!") after which he's off to explore and grow his brand (Dave asked for tour cities/venues — unanswered); Calvin then got excited about the tour stops ("We're hitting some awesome spots - it's gonna be epic!"), Dave said live music is the best and offered to show Calvin around his garage and its cool cars (shared a photo of the garage — a car in a garage with a Coca-Cola sign — "looks stunning!"), and Calvin accepted the garage-tour offer (hoping for ideas for future projects) and re-pledged to let Dave know when he's in Boston, and the chat closed with mutual goodbyes; on 2023-09-02, reconnected with Dave ("Hey Calvin! Been a while, what's up?"): said Dave must feel great making a real difference in someone's life — "like being their superhero!" — and that he should be proud of bringing joy to others, then told Dave he booked a flight to Boston last week (~2023-08-26 through 09-01) and is "so excited" about the upcoming trip, sharing a photo of a book with a boarding pass on it; he'll let Dave know when he's in Boston, and Dave told him to let him know when he's free so they can catch up in Boston (see the Boston trip section); the chat closed with mutual goodbyes and Calvin promising to contact Dave when he arrives; on 2023-08-31, told Dave the tour was amazing ("so pumped from all the energy from the audience"; performing on the big stage was "a dream come true" — he "felt on top of the world" and it was "seriously surreal"; photo of a crowd watching a concert with a large screen), and that he started shooting a video for his new album last weekend (~2023-08-25/26) — the shoot is in Miami on an awesome beach, "It's going to have some epic visuals!" (photo of a camera and a video camera on a beach); the chat also ended with Dave complimenting Calvin's custom octopus guitar (made by his Japanese artist friend; one of Calvin's favorites, a reminder of his passion for music and friendships; photo of a guitar with an octopus on it; custom shiny purple finish he chose because it's unique and goes with his style, and Calvin — who values staying true to himself and being unique in his music — glad Dave appreciates it); Dave then affirmed that staying true to yourself and your style is vital and makes Calvin unique and his music stand out ("Keep it real, bud. You've got something great to give the world.") and Dave offering to help with props for the video; on 2023-08-22, told Dave he scored a deal to continue collaborating with Frank Ocean ("a dream come true" — he met Frank at a Tokyo music festival and they clicked, and they recorded a song in Calvin's mansion studio; of the festival: the city was "buzzing with energy" and the crowd "like fuel for my soul"; later on 2023-08-22: said someone noticed his performance and now they're working together, that his tour ends soon and he's heading to Boston where he proposed meeting Dave, and that on 2023-08-21 he recorded a podcast with his friends about the "rapidly evolving rap industry" (will let Dave know when it uploads)), and on 2023-08-14, his tour with a well-known artist ended with a show in Tokyo ("awesome": the crowd sang along to his song, a "magical moment"; shared a photo of a concert crowd with hands up — these moments are why he loves his job; the show was "buzzing", these moments are "what make me so proud and motivated", and he's "all about spreading joy with my art"), and he got to explore his new place in Japan ("like a dream come true"); also on 2023-08-14, the chat with Dave turned to Dave's car restoration (photo of a car with a broken engine in the woods; Calvin: "going to look amazing", asked how long it would take) and closed with Calvin cheering Dave on ("You got this, Dave! I'm always here for you... Keep growing, buddy. See ya!"); as of 2023-08-03, revealed his red luxury sports car is a Ferrari and said its recent service was very stressful (he's attached to it; at the Ferrari dealership he saw lots of amazing cars but his is the best — "it reminds me of my hard work and dedication"; photo of the red car on a lift in a garage); on 2023-07-21, is transforming his Japanese mansion into a recording studio (his dream of a space for creating music with other artists, his "sanctuary" that reminds him why he loves music; shared a progress photo), and experimenting with new genres — adding electronic elements to his songs for a "fresh vibe", finding the balance between sticking to his sound and trying new stuff "intimidating" but motivating; says he started making music to follow his dreams, is "stoked" about how far he's come, and that collaborating with others, learning from them, and surrounding himself with positive energy and passion keep him motivated under the pressure; as of 2023-07-07 the car is fixed and going strong after the 2023-06-16 accident ("Nothing better than cruising around"; photo of the red sports car parked on the side of the road), and he revealed he's living in a Japanese mansion with an "epic" cityscape ("like a dream come true"; backyard photo of a boat docked in a canal at sunset; photo of the mansion front with lots of windows and lights); on 2023-06-21: car accident on 2023-06-16 (red sports car on a sidewalk, no one hurt): insurance was a slow, paperwork-heavy hassle but sorted in a week and cost "wasn't too bad"; car at an auto repair shop with a skilled mechanic; earlier (2023-06-09): met with the creative team for his album on 2023-06-08, "stoked" and "everything coming together"; explicitly never been to Boston and can't wait to visit in July 2023 (heard the parks are amazing); on 2023-06-09 also shared a photo of a plane flying over snowy mountains — has never been to the mountains but is keen to go on a hike there to "escape it all and de-stress"; earlier (2023-05-31): touring with Frank Ocean the week before (~2023-05-22/28), Tokyo stop "unreal" (insane crowd, felt alive performing), Boston a tour stop ("Gonna be great playing for folks from home"); performing live "always fuels my soul" — "an absolute high"; finds working on/fixing cars relaxing, like meditation; earlier: home music studio, saved gear from a home flood, new mansion ("new mansion"), a red luxury sports car, Tokyo music festival (April 2023), and a world-tour dream. As of 2023-06-21 also has a small town in Japan with an "unbelievably stunning" mountain view on his to-do list to visit after the Frank Ocean tour ends; on the same day, said he has never tried skiing but it looks like "a lot of fun" and he might try it once. As of 2023-07-07, is working on music collaborations with Japanese artists (promised Dave clips when ready) and looking forward to trying the Japanese food and checking out the culture. Also on 2023-08-03: his plan for now is to expand his brand worldwide and grow his fanbase (music reaching more people, making an impact; goals too: working with artists from around the globe, challenging himself to create special music); shared a photo of performing with his band "the boys" on 2023-08-02 ("they are great at the music"); and says seeing his Ferrari everyday keeps him motivated and reminds him to keep pushing. On 2023-08-11, praised Dave's attention to detail on the car mod project and — being busy with his own music — kept Dave's offer of a hand at Dave's music studio in mind; the conversation ended with Dave wishing him good luck with his music and the two exchanging goodbyes.]
